jobs.description:
**Job Requisition ID:**
182830
  
  
**About Al-Futtaim**
Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.
  
  
**Overview Of The Role:**

* As a Brand Manager for Jewelry & Accessories, your role is to lead the commercial, operational, and customer performance of the business. You will drive sustainable sales and profit growth while maintaining brand equity and ensuring exceptional customer experience across all channels. With full accountability for trading performance, merchandising, marketing execution, store operations, and inventory management, you will also focus on people development. Collaboration with various teams, including Planning, Supply Chain, Finance, HR, and Retail Operations, is essential to achieve business objectives and support regional growth opportunities.

**What You Will Do:**
General
  
  

* Lead the commercial, operational, and customer performance of the Jewelry & Accessories business to achieve sustainable sales and profit growth.
* End-to-end accountability for trading performance, merchandising, marketing execution, store operations, inventory management, and team development.
* Partner with Planning, Supply Chain, Finance, HR, and Retail Operations teams to deliver business objectives and support growth opportunities.
* Develop and execute commercial strategies to achieve revenue, margin, and profitability objectives across all channels.
* Optimize assortment, stock levels, and inventory productivity by collaborating with planning and buying teams.
* Work closely with brand principals to define seasonal collections and assortments, maximizing inventory productivity within Open-to-Buy budgets.
* Collaborate with marketing teams to implement campaigns, launches, and activations that increase traffic and brand awareness.
* Implement the visual strategy of the brands across stores to ensure consistent brand presentation and an engaging customer experience.
* Identify opportunities for expansion, category growth, and omnichannel development to support long-term business performance.

**Required Skills To Be Successful:**

* Advanced skills in commercial and financial analysis, including budgeting and forecasting.
* Expertise in retail operations management and inventory and merchandise management.
* Strong capabilities in customer experience management and strategic growth initiatives.
* Collaborative leadership with a focus on results orientation, strategic thinking, and adaptability.

**What Qualifies You For The Role:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Retail Management, Fashion Merchandising, Marketing or related discipline.
* 5-8 years' experience within retail, fashion, jewelry, accessories or lifestyle brands; commercialization and P&L management.
* Strong analytical and financial acumen, with expertise in merchandising, inventory planning, and retail operations management.
* Experience managing multiple stores and cross-functional teams; proven ability to deliver sales and profit growth in fast-paced environments.

**About Al-Futtaim Retail**
At Al-Futtaim Retail, we are part of a 90-year legacy built on ambition, progress and long-term vision. As one of the region’s leading retail operators, we partner with some of the world’s most trusted brands – including IKEA, ACE, Marks & Spencer and the Inditex Group – bringing global excellence to customers across MENA and Southeast Asia.
  
  
We don’t just operate stores; we shape retail experiences. From launching brands like Watsons and Kiabi to our regions for the first time, to investing in digital innovation, AI capabilities, the customer experience and loyalty platforms, we are constantly redefining the future of retail.
  
  
With over 100 nationalities spread across more than 10 countries, our strength lies in our diverse and collaborative community. Here, you’re equipped to turn your ambition into action, building the career you want, while helping us move retail forwards.
  
  
Join us and be part of The Heart of Tomorrow.

The Airline Wine Category Manager supports the day-to-day management and coordination of the Emirates wine programme across all cabin classes and lounges. The **CRM & Lifecycle Marketing Manager** maximises the commercial effectiveness of CRM across 30+ schools in the Middle East, India and Asia, improving customer progression and conversion through effective lifecycle journeys, automation, segmentation, personalisation and continuous optimisation.

The role translates Group CRM strategy, lifecycle frameworks and platform capability into a **prioritised divisional CRM and lifecycle Marketing improvement roadmap**, using customer, funnel and market evidence to determine where intervention will have the greatest commercial impact.

Operating within Group-owned CRM strategy, architecture, governance, data standards and common lifecycle frameworks, the role leads the CRM Executive / Specialist and acts as the principal divisional interface with Group CRM / Technology. Admissions, Retention and school teams retain accountability for their respective customer processes and operational outcomes.

**ROLE IN THE OPERATING MODEL / SCOPE**

* **Owns CRM & lifecycle Marketing performance and optimisation across MEA.**
* **Enables rather than replaces business ownership of customer processes.**  
  Admissions, Retention and school teams retain ownership of customer processes and outcomes within their remit, including data capture, lead follow-up and customer intervention. CRM & Lifecycle Marketing improves these processes through journeys, automation, segmentation, communications and insight.

* **Manages divisional CRM demand within enterprise governance.**  
  Manages CRM demand, optimisation and delegated administration through the COE intake and prioritisation process. Own the CRM improvement roadmap, using customer, funnel and CRM performance evidence to prioritise capability, adoption and optimisation interventions across 30+ schools according to commercial impact and customer need.

Ability to analyse journey and conversion performance, define useful CRM measures and reporting requirements, and run structured experimentation that produces actionable learning.

**Marketing Manager**
to join
**MultiBank Exchange,**
our leading institutional Electronic Communication Network (ECN) providing deep liquidity, competitive pricing, and advanced execution solutions to financial institutions, brokers, hedge funds, proprietary trading firms, asset managers, and other professional market participants. Our technology-driven platform delivers transparent access to global FX liquidity while enabling clients to optimize execution quality and trading performance.

**Role Overview**

You will own MultiBank Exchange’s global marketing: brand, content, digital, events and sales enablement, with the aim of growing the Exchange’s global market penetration among institutional clients. This is a hands-on role for someone who already knows the institutional FX and electronic trading world and can explain it credibly to a trader, a head of FX or a prime-of-prime desk.

You will work day to day with the commercial, product, technology and liquidity teams, and with senior leadership. You will also draw on MultiBank Group’s existing web, video, events and design teams, so this role is about directing and coordinating shared resources as much as producing work yourself.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy and brand**

* Build and run MultiBank Exchange’s global marketing plan, tied to commercial targets and reviewed quarterly.
* Sharpen the Exchange’s positioning against other institutional liquidity venues, and keep messaging consistent across every channel.
* Build regional market-entry and expansion plans, and identify new segments, regions and partnerships that raise visibility and grow global market penetration.

**Content and product marketing**

* Produce product collateral, thought leadership, case studies, videos, email and social content that explain the Exchange’s liquidity and execution features in terms clients care about.
* Keep all materials accurate and current, working with product, technology and liquidity teams.

**Digital and market growth**

* Own the Exchange website, including content, conversion and performance.
* Plan and run multi-channel campaigns (LinkedIn, email, paid, trade media) and report on reach, engagement and penetration by region and client segment.
* Use analytics to decide what to stop, change and scale.

**Events, PR and communications**

* Work with MultiBank Group’s events team to run the Exchange’s presence at industry conferences, exhibitions, webinars and client events, and measure the return on each.
* Manage PR agencies and trade media relationships; write press releases, announcements and executive profiles.
* Build relationships with industry bodies, partners and key stakeholders.

**Sales enablement**

* Work with the institutional sales team on account-based campaigns and client acquisition plans.
* Create pitch decks, one-pagers, brochures and other sales tools, and support product launches.

**Governance and collaboration**

* Ensure all external content goes through compliance review and meets financial promotion rules in each market we target.
* Manage designers, agencies and vendors, and the marketing budget.
* Work with MultiBank Group’s existing teams for web, video, events, design and PR, and agree priorities, turnaround times and ownership with each so Exchange work is delivered on time and on brand.
* Make sure the Exchange’s institutional positioning is protected when shared Group teams and assets are used, and adapt Group content that is aimed at retail audiences.
* Track competitors, industry developments and market trends, and share what you learn with leadership and sales.

**Requirements**

**Essential**

* 5+ years of B2B marketing in institutional FX, liquidity providers, electronic trading, capital markets or fintech.
* A track record of delivering integrated marketing plans that produced measurable market growth, not only activity.
* Working knowledge of institutional FX market structure: liquidity, execution quality, prime brokerage and the main client types.
* Strong writing and the ability to turn technical concepts into clear client-facing messaging.
* Hands-on experience with website management, a marketing automation or CRM platform, and campaign analytics.
* Experience running events and working with PR agencies.
* Sound project and stakeholder management, and a comfortable working relationship with compliance in a regulated environment.

**Desirable**

* Previous experience at an institutional trading venue, a liquidity provider, a prime broker or an institutional trading technology vendor.
* An existing network among institutional FX participants.
* Account-based marketing experience.
* Experience marketing across multiple regions, such as MENA, Europe and APAC.
* Additional languages.

**Why Join Us?**

* Work within a high-growth, industry-leading global financial institution.
* Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.
* Fast-paced environment with significant ownership and career advancement opportunities.
* Collaborative, diverse, and high-performance engineering culture.
* Opportunity to contribute to mission-critical trading applications used worldwide

**About the role**
------------------

We are looking for a hands-on, strategic Marketing Manager to join the AltoVita team, reporting directly to the Director of Marketing. This is a broad role for a well-rounded marketer who is comfortable switching between strategy and execution: writing an award submission in the morning, running an event logistics call in the afternoon, and challenging the marketing plan when something isn't working. We want someone who brings ideas, questions assumptions and helps shape where AltoVita's marketing goes next, as well as delivering it.

**What you will achieve in your first 6 months**
------------------------------------------------

* **Win industry recognition.** Own AltoVita's awards programme end-to-end, with a focus on our priority awards (the EMMAs and Business Travel Awards). You will select the right categories, build the evidence and write winning submissions.
* **Deliver flawless events.** Take full ownership of event execution from A to Z, including our annual Smart, Safe & Sustainable Summit, industry conferences such as GBTA, ProcureCon and the AltoLive webinar series. This covers planning, budgets, suppliers, speakers, promotion, on-the-day delivery, follow-up and ROI reporting.
* **Raise our online presence.** Sharpen AltoVita's brand awareness and thought leadership, especially on LinkedIn, by shifting toward fewer, more strategic and higher-impact posts. Grow engagement and net new followers along the way.
* **Own the quarterly Corporate Accommodation Trends Report.** Lead the research, writing, production and promotion of each edition, and turn it into a recurring thought-leadership engine across webinars, PR, social and sales.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop and own the marketing content strategy, with content themes that resonate with our target audiences and align with company objectives and AltoVita's unique selling propositions.
* Shape and master the AltoVita voice on social platforms, building strong relationships with our audience, especially on LinkedIn.
* Craft compelling online and offline content, from SEO-driven and long-form pieces to thought leadership and product content.
* Identify the leading industry awards for AltoVita and write submissions ranging from 200 to 2,000 words. Manage deadlines, evidence gathering and stakeholder input.
* Research industry trends to produce whitepapers, benchmarking reports and industry reports, in collaboration with the demand and supply sectors AltoVita serves.
* Plan and run AltoLive webinars, including topics, speakers, moderation, promotion and repurposing content afterwards.
* Lead AltoVita's online and in-person event marketing, managing budgets and measuring each event's contribution to pipeline.
* Produce case studies and sales materials in collaboration with the Product, Sales and Customer Success teams.
* Contribute engaging content to email marketing, including the AltoVita newsletter and account-based marketing campaigns, in collaboration with the Director of Marketing.
* Contribute to PR initiatives by gathering data and stories for press releases and interviewing leadership and team members for news stories.
* Work closely with our in-house designer on all creative and graphic needs.
* Build cross-functional relationships to find storytelling and promotional opportunities, and support the Sales, Product, Supply and Customer Success teams with marketing initiatives that meet business objectives.
* Bring strategic input to the marketing plan. Challenge priorities, propose new channels and ideas, and use data to recommend where to invest.
* Measure marketing performance regularly across leads, pipeline influence, engagement and reach, and report insights and recommendations.
* Maintain brand standards and tone of voice across all communication channels.
* Keep learning about trends in corporate housing, serviced apartments, global mobility, business travel and hospitality.

**Requirements**
----------------

* 3+ years of B2B marketing experience across content, events and brand. Experience in hospitality, travel, global mobility or technology is strongly preferred.
* A proven track record of writing award submissions, ideally including wins.
* End-to-end ownership of events, both in person and virtual, including budgets, suppliers and ROI measurement.
* Exceptional written English with flawless grammar. Please be prepared to share writing samples.
* Experience producing research-led content such as reports, whitepapers or benchmarking studies.
* Experience growing a B2B brand on LinkedIn, with a strong grasp of thought-leadership content.
* Hands-on experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM and marketing automation platform.
* Strategic thinking combined with a willingness to roll up your sleeves, and the confidence to challenge and influence stakeholders, including senior leadership.
* Strong project management skills, consistency and attention to detail. You can juggle multiple deadlines without dropping the ball.
* A self-starter who thrives in a fast-moving, remote environment with high autonomy.
* Strong verbal communication and presentation skills, including comfort moderating webinars and representing AltoVita at events.

### **Description**

Operating in the UAE for over 50 years, CBD manages the financial requirements of some of the largest corporates and businesses operating in the country, driving the UAE economy. The Senior Product Manager, Business Banking - Assets is responsible for defining and executing the product strategy for the bank’s business banking asset portfolio. The role drives sustainable growth, profitability, customer value, and portfolio quality across lending solutions, including working capital, term finance, trade-related facilities, and secured and unsecured business loans. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Banking, or a related discipline; a relevant postgraduate qualification or MBA is preferred.

Minimum 8 years of relevant banking experience, including at least 5 years in business banking, SME or commercial lending product management.

Demonstrated experience managing asset products across the full lifecycle, from proposition design and governance through launch and performance optimization.

Strong knowledge of lending structures, pricing, credit assessment, collateral, portfolio risk, and the regulatory environment.

Proven ability to develop business cases and interpret financial, customer, market, and portfolio data.

Strong stakeholder leadership, communication, negotiation, and programme-delivery capabilities.

Proficiency in Excel and data-visualization tools; knowledge of SQL or other analytics tools is an advantage.
